name: mcal_add_guests
description: Add one or more guests (attendees) to an event by `id` in a calendar (`calendar` slug). Each guest is an email (optionally a name). Idempotent per email. Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Resolve people to emails via Metalcraft Contacts (mcon_search) first; never invent an address. Returns the event's full guest list (email, name, rsvp). Guests appear on mcal_get_event; to hold a video call, add a meeting to the event as well.

id.description: Event id (UUID) to add guests to.
